points.description: States TRUE (the user process cannot force/initiate a context switch to a chosen process).
Justification: the scheduler (OS kernel) alone decides which READY process runs next; the user process has no control over scheduling choice, even knowing the PID.
points.partial_credit: Give 0.75 if the justification is vague, e.g. only says user processes lack privilege or the OS handles scheduling, without saying the user process cannot choose the next process.

rubric.notes: Full marks: TRUE with a reason that the scheduler/OS, not the user process, decides who runs next. Part marks: TRUE with a vague or incomplete reason (e.g. context switching is a kernel matter). No marks if the answer says FALSE or gives no justification; per the question, a correct justification is needed for any marks.
